SwitchPreference.android:title: Start at Boot
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Automatically run DFRoot on device boot

Preference.android:title: Disable automatic startup
Preference.android:summary: Explicitly turn automatic startup OFF. Safe to use even when status cannot be read; nothing is ever turned ON by this action.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Auto Soft Reboot
SwitchPreference.android:summary: EXPERIMENTAL — manual runs only. Unattended Start at Boot remains disabled while this is enabled, pending hardware validation.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Disable KSU Modules
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Turn this on if a broken module is crashing your device. The next run will launch with all modules disabled.
